from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4f969483.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # The three-color seed is the consecutive run in the first row.
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(out[0]) if v]
    colors = [out[0][c] for c in cols]
    if len(cols) != 3:
        return out
    # Outer seed colors extend toward matching isolated markers as an L.
    for color, col in ((colors[0], cols[0]), (colors[2], cols[2])):
        points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                  if out[r][c] == color and r != 0]
        if not points:
            continue
        r, c = points[0]
        for rr in range(min(r, 0), max(r, 0) + 1):
            out[rr][col] = color
        for cc in range(min(c, col), max(c, col) + 1):
            out[r][cc] = color
    # Middle seed color forms a full vertical line.
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][cols[1]] = colors[1]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
